sahneler.metin: Seconds after lift-off, Apollo 12 was struck by lightning.
Seconds later it was hit again, and warnings flooded the cabin.
The rocket itself had triggered the lightning in the clouds.
Fuel cells dropped offline and the data went haywire.
An engineer on the ground recalled an obscure switch setting.
The mission went on to land on the Moon.
Launch rules now forbid flying through clouds like these.

aciklama:
Apollo 12 was hit by lightning during launch. The cause: vehicle-triggered lightning knocking fuel cells offline and scrambling telemetry.
